name: Seasons Textiles Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Seasons Textiles Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing, trading, and export of Furnishing Fabrics.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
STL is the flagship company of the Seasons Group. It is in the business of manufacturing 
of Furnishing Fabrics/Technical Textiles (Flame Retardant), along with export and trading in furnishing fabrics and made-ups

pros: Stock is trading at 0.41 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 164 days to 129 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -4.06% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.97% over last 3 years.
